description: Integrate and review PR targets through the shared local repair batch, then reconcile applicable whole-story proof and closeout.

steps.label: Review PR Candidates And Repair Valid Findings
Run PR Feedback Through Existing Review Batch Gates
Reply To Findings After Disposition And Repair
Repeat Only For Useful Review Of A Changed Candidate
steps.question: Read-only: identify this PR review invocation and current round from the running pr_review_current_plan conversation. GET /conversations returns items and nextCursor: inspect the parent flags.flow.loopStack and flags.flow.subflowWaveProgress.jobs, including the pr_review_batch:local_review_batch instanceId and conversationId; match the child by conversationId, flowName and flags.flowChild executionId, instanceId and waveInvocationId. Read the child flags.flow.values.review_batch_targets from GET /conversations and its terminal, status and terminalOutcome from GET /flows/runs/{conversationId}; that endpoint does not return flags. Bind the actual current wave and child to its immutable batch and active cycle, cross-checking batch-launch.md and job.md instance IDs beginning pr_target_reviews:. If either API lookup is unavailable, use independently attributable exact current-batch launch, snapshot, gates, disposition, completed-fix records, outcome, PR reply assessment and fresh target Git evidence when sufficient; never substitute an older batch or guess identity. Preserve missing or partial coverage as incomplete. A fix-bearing HEAD must contain an attributable source or test Git commit and remote review must be pinned to the exact pushed HEAD. Read the current batch target snapshot, applicable gates and dispositions, repair evidence, outcome and PR reply assessment, then current Git HEAD for each target. Return exact JSON only: {"answer":"yes"} or {"answer":"no"}. Answer no for a verified new committed fix-bearing HEAD needing pinned remote review when safe publication and observation are available. Also answer no for a newly arrived potential-issue source comment requiring disposition, including one ultimately rejected or duplicate, when it has not yet had its one same-head gates-only pass. Reuse the existing launch in that pass: no request, push or description refresh. An existing authoritative applicable disposition permits the reply owner to answer a late duplicate directly. Never repeat the same comment's gates-only pass, reopen disposed or exhausted findings without material new evidence, or repeat an unchanged candidate's launch. Failed or ambiguous posting, missing evidence, and unchanged unavailable coverage do not justify repeating; preserve uncertainty for settlement rather than claiming clean coverage. A changed candidate invalidates old clean coverage; independently useful changed targets must still be processed.

steps.label: Whole Story Proof After PR Review
Skip Proof Only For Positively Unchanged Phase
steps.question: Read-only: separate review coverage from source/test changes since the last applicable whole-story proof. Attribute integration and the entire PR review phase and all rounds, including earlier fixes, cross-target repairs, resumed work and failed or absent launches, using the active cycle, matching parent and child conversations from GET /conversations (items, flags.flow and flags.flowChild), terminal status from GET /flows/runs/{conversationId}, and exact immutable batch and job evidence with instance IDs beginning pr_target_reviews:. Compare the last applicable proof candidate to fresh owned Git provenance in every target: integration commits and other committed source/test changes, staged and unstaged source/test diffs and relevant untracked source/tests, including established owned changes that were later reverted. Compare history, not only the final tree or last round. Plan-only changes do not invalidate proof. A failed launch or partial review coverage alone does not establish a code/test change or invalidate verified unchanged proof; preserve coverage as incomplete. Honor ownership, the selected story and task testing restrictions, and continue safe independent proof. Return exact JSON only: {"answer":"yes"} or {"answer":"no"}. Answer no when any verified source/test change occurred since the last applicable proof and the current candidate can safely receive proof, even if the final tree matches the earlier candidate. Answer yes when the candidate is positively unchanged and existing proof applies, or when the candidate is genuinely unknown and proof must remain pending; leave unknown and incomplete coverage for closeout to reconcile and continue safe independent work. Never claim unknown is unchanged or proved.

steps.label: Run Whole Story Proof After PR Review

content: Read and apply $CODEINFO_ROOT/codeinfo_markdown/local_review_closeout.md where applicable. Independently reconcile every actual PR wave and immutable batch, exact pushed PR-reviewed heads, reviewer coverage, reply and disposition assessments, patch and test evidence, verified and unverified fixes, pending findings, and applicable whole-story proof. Establish each round from the running PR flow wave/child outcomes and immutable batch job instances beginning pr_target_reviews:, not the latest-batch pointer; retain unknown coverage when association cannot be established. Reconcile missing completed-fix tasks only as the existing local closeout rules permit. Account for integration and all review rounds since the last applicable proof, owned dirty or reverted source/test changes where established, and proof outcomes under the selected story and testing restrictions. If final proof changes source or tests after an exact PR review, retain that candidate as unreviewed and review coverage incomplete. Preserve per-provider refusal, quota and failure alongside useful sibling findings; a terminal provider decline alone does not force the cycle incomplete. Preserve original open work, existing parent-consumed results, human-pending proof and all uncertainty; do not create deferred tasks or blocker records, launch another review or proof, commit or push.

Settle the existing active final review cycle using the current cycle ID and scripts/record_review_cycle_outcome.py: record completed only when trustworthy evidence establishes the PR pass is fully settled with exact-head coverage, dispositions, replies, verified repairs and applicable proof; otherwise record incomplete with a precise reason. If settlement is unavailable, report it honestly. Do not initialize another cycle.
